crop: RGB, centered 256x256, floor integer offset, no resizing
channel: AWGN, existing method-specific paid-information protocols and SNR conventions
var_condition: null class embedding only; no source label or inferred class is supplied
var_sampling: Existing deterministic argmax completion with received tokens overwritten in raster order
bpg_source_rule: Reuse frozen TX resolution/QP selection by complete file bytes and source MSE; no noisy-output selection
swin: Fixed adapted 80000-update checkpoint; 19 dB outside training/calibration range
failure_policy: Retain every registered frame and original method failure output; software failures are not converted to gray images

statistics.reduction: Three noise realizations averaged within each source; sources equally weighted
statistics.paired_comparisons: VAR_UNCONDITIONAL minus each of P1024, BPG_ADAPTIVE, SWIN80K on matched sources

limitations: Only 24 fixed center crops; not native-resolution Kodak image transmission
A different benchmark does not certify absence of overlap in all pretrained foundation-model corpora
Source prediction agreement is a proxy, not ground-truth classification accuracy
Matched noise labels do not imply identical received observations across different waveforms
